metadata.title: Measurement
metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.subtitle: Mastering Measurement
metadata.author: EduOS AI Architect
learning_outcomes: Understand the core concepts of Measurement
Connect the concept to real-world examples

ai_context.learning_goal: Ensure complete mastery of Measurement for a Class 1 student.
common_misconceptions: Students often confuse the basic definition.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Use the real-world analogies provided in the hook and connection blocks.

blocks.title: Big, Small, Heavy, Light!
blocks.body: Is an elephant heavier than a mouse? Are you taller than your bag?

blocks.question: Which is longer?
blocks.explanation: A school bus is much longer!

blocks.back: A rock is Heavy. A feather is Light.

blocks.title: Measuring Length
blocks.body: We can measure how long things are using rulers, handspans, or footsteps. We use words like Long, Short, Tall, and Short.

blocks.question: Which is the tallest?
blocks.explanation: Giraffes have very long necks and are very tall!

blocks.title: Capacity
blocks.body: We also measure how much a container can hold. A bucket holds MORE water than a cup!

blocks.title: Comparing Weight
blocks.body: A watermelon is Heavy. An apple is Light.

blocks.question: Which holds more water?
blocks.explanation: A swimming pool holds a massive amount of water!
